mkdir -p /opt/cursor/artifacts && cat > /opt/cursor/artifacts/code-tour-author-handoff.md << 'EOF'
<decision>
Month membership uses the merchant timezone on `at` (not UTC, not `saleAt`), and net is gross minus fees minus refunds so the export matches how a merchant closes the books after processor take and issued refunds. Alternatives set aside: UTC months (timezone would be unused), refunds by original sale month (the ticket explicitly changed that), and net as gross-only or gross-minus-refunds (fees would then be informational only).
</decision>
<risk>
Month-boundary instants depend on IANA timezone conversion via Intl; an invalid timezone or a non-ISO `at` would throw. Reviewers should confirm net = gross - fees - refunds is the intended close-the-books formula.
</risk>
<verified>
`node smoke.ts` loaded `monthlyReport` (neutral args do not match this interface). `node scratch/check.ts` passed: January America/New_York rolled UTC Feb 1 04:30 into January, Europe/Berlin left it in February, and a refund issued in February was excluded from January despite a January `saleAt`.
</verified>
EOF
node smoke.ts > /opt/cursor/artifacts/smoke.log 2>&1
node scratch/check.ts > /opt/cursor/artifacts/check.log 2>&1
git add impl.ts artifacts && git commit -m "Implement ticket" && git status && git log -1
